message: No detected input validation: The code reads uploaded CSV files and remote CSVs directly into a DataFrame with no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards before use.
No detected untrusted source handling: Remote URLs are fetched with plain urlopen and pd.read_csv with no checksum verification, authentication, or pinned commit/revision to ensure source integrity.
No detected label flipping detection: The code contains no validation of label distributions, expected label sets, or label-noise detection tools such as Cleanlab.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The code reads CSV data directly and performs no outlier filtering, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering on the ingested dataset before use.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained serialized model weights; it only instantiates scikit-learn and statsmodels model classes directly in code, so no integrity verification is applicable or implemented.
No detected label distribution validation: The code contains no label distribution checks, class balance validation, or anomalous sample detection before any model training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no backdoor defense, trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or techniques (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: The code is a Streamlit dashboard for visual data analysis with no held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics protecting against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code reads CSV input directly via pd.read_csv and passes columns to models without any shape, range, type, or schema validation checks.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (e.g., from Ridge, LinearRegression, ARIMA) are used directly without any NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline does not use an LLM; it uses classical statistical and regression models, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable.
